721530101.text: Hey! Traveler, why are you here?

721530105.text: After you helped me gather some materials previously, I was preparing to write a thesis on Visions and elemental powers.

721530106.text: The outline was drawn up, the materials were found, and you were a special example of someone who does not have Vision but could still use the power of the elements.

721530107.text: So I wrote up the first draft and sent it to the Akademiya for my tutor to review, but...

721530108.text: "The topic is shallow, the logic is unclear, the content is rambling and incomprehensible."

721530109.text: My paper was summarily rejected. Again.

721530110.text: So it's a rewrite for you, then?

721530111.text: Yeah. Hahaha... Well, I've rewritten it twice already. What's another time?

721530112.text: The first time, I wanted to go to Mondstadt to collect data and to write a paper about life in Mondstadt and The Four Winds.

721530113.text: But as soon as I passed the Stone Gate, I heard that The Dragon of the East, Dvalin, who should be one of The Four Winds of Mondstadt, had suddenly started attacking the city of Mondstadt.

721530114.text: I specifically went to Mondstadt to consult with Mr. Sayid, but he didn't know the reason either, and couldn't help me with my paper.

721530115.text: Since I didn't have a core argument or any evidence, I had to change the topic...

721530117.text: Yes! I thought that since the Geo Archon in Liyue is so diligent, and personally guards Liyue Harbor, and also helps to guide its overall development...

721530118.text: If I wrote a paper on the relationship between the Geo Archon and Liyue Harbor, there should be enough material.

721530119.text: And then— and then, Morax suddenly... Ohh...

721530104.text: Ugh, don't even mention my paper...

721530201.text: So that's what Inazuman specialties are like... Hmm...

721530203.text: Hello! I'm Alrani, a scholar from Sumeru. I'm doing research on Inazuma for an academic paper.

721530204.text: Investigating us at a time like this? So suspicious...

721530205.text: I don't care what your purpose is. You're disturbing me, so just leave.

subQuests.subQuestName: Take a photo of Eipekkusu and its owner

721530303.text: A researcher from the Akademiya, right? I didn't expect to see someone like you here...

721530305.text: I just had to take one look at you to know you're a researcher. There's plenty of them back in Sumeru after all.

721530306.text: Did you come all the way here from Sumeru to Inazuma for this... so-called "sociological study"?

721530307.text: Yes. I'm just making some preparations. Are you also from the Akademiya...?

721530308.text: No, I haven't the talent to be an academic. I'm just an ordinary businessman.

721530309.text: Since you're writing a paper, you can record whatever you like here if you want, but first, let me give you some advice.

721530310.text: The Outlander Affairs Agency is wary of outlanders like us, so remember to be a bit more restrained while you're doing your research.

721530311.text: If you get into any trouble, it would be hard for an outlander like you, who's only just come to Inazuma, to extricate themselves.

721530313.text: Well, off you go then. Start writing stuff down.

subQuests.subQuestName: Take a photo of Syavushi Bakshesh Shoppe and its owner

721530601.text: What can you make with <color=#00E1FFFF>a portion of Fish</color>, <color=#00E1FFFF>a portion of Seagrass</color> and <color=#00E1FFFF>a portion of Rice</color>, anyway?

721530901.text: *sigh* Didn't I just tell you? Don't do anything suspicious.

721530902.text: You still haven't gotten all your permits squared away. If the Outlander Affairs Agency got involved, there would be no way to resolve things peacefully. Fortunately, I was paying attention to what you were doing.

721530904.text: Well, they are that serious. See the checkpoint in Ritou? If you want to enter Inazuma, you need to get a permit.

721530908.text: Oh no, does this mean that I can't go to the other islands to collect data?

721530909.text: Don't worry. I've asked around at the Outlander Affairs Agency before. As it turns out, it might be easier to get a permit if you apply under me, since I'm a businessman here in Inazuma.

721530910.text: Th—Thank you... but why do you want to help me?

721530906.text: Now, I'm not too sure from where I sit, but I'm pretty sure not having a license is a no-go.

721530907.text: See the checkpoint in Ritou? If you want to enter Inazuma, you need to get a permit.

721531101.text: Hello! You two, what are you doing?

721531102.text: Hello! I'm Alrani, a scholar from Sumeru. I'm doing some academic research here.

721531103.text: Research? I'm a fisherman. What's there to research?

721531104.text: And do you have permission from the Outlander Affairs Agency to do... suspicious things like that?

721531105.text: I heard from Gonshirou that this kind of behavior should be reported to the Agency first, right?

721531108.text: Eh? Why? Is there such a thing? I've never heard that one before!

721531109.text: You're getting more and more suspicious by the minute... You'd better come and see Miss Kageyama with me.

721531110.text: She is an inspector with the Agency. She'd know how to handle your affairs.

721531111.text: Wait, hold on. I'm really just an academic researcher... I'll go report to the agency later...

721531112.text: Mr. Obata, what's going on here? I could hear the row from all the way over there.

721531113.text: Oh, it's Mr. Vahid. Well, these two have been loitering around, claiming to be doing some kind of academic research.

721531114.text: But when I asked, they don't seem to have permission from the Outlander Affairs Agency. I was going to take them to see Miss Kageyama.

721531115.text: Alrani, what are you running around for? Shouldn't you be helping at the store?

721530401.text: *sigh* Didn't I just tell you? Don't do anything suspicious.

721530402.text: The current situation in Inazuma is such that, if the Outlander Affairs Agency got involved, there would be no way to resolve things peacefully. Fortunately, I was paying attention to what you were doing.

721530404.text: Yes, they are that serious. See the checkpoint in Ritou? If you want to enter Inazuma, you need to get a permit.

721530408.text: Oh no, does this mean that I can't go to the other islands to collect data?

721530409.text: Don't worry. I've asked around at the Outlander Affairs Agency before. As it turns out, it might be easier to get a permit if you apply under me, since I'm a businessman here in Inazuma.

721530410.text: Th—Thank you... but why do you want to help me?

721530406.text: I can't be too sure from where I'm at. But judging by how tense the Kanjou Commissioners are, the situation can't be good.

721530407.text: See the checkpoint in Ritou? If you want to enter Inazuma, you need to get a permit.

721530701.text: Don't worry, it's more than sufficient. Just a moment. It'll be ready soon.

721530702.text: Wow... It looks delicious. You're a great cook.

721530703.text: Haha, if you live alone for a long time, you will naturally learn this kind of thing. Go on, dig in.

721530704.text: I'm also doing this for the business. In the beginning, I was thinking about many different ways to market our fertilizer.

721530705.text: One thing I thought of was to use the vegetables grown with my fertilizer as ingredients to make delicious food, which would help prove their efficacy.

721530706.text: But later, I realized that the idea of cooking in a fertilizer shop was a little... inappropriate, so I gave up.

721530707.text: It is a bit out of place...

721530708.text: Of course, now that I have Miss Alrani's help, I won't have to come up with these terrible ideas by myself.

721530709.text: I'll do my best! But about the issue with the travel permit...

721530710.text: Leave it to me. If there are no problems, it should be done in just a few days.

721530711.text: Still, a researcher coming to Inazuma is a rare sight. What sort of paper are you writing?

721530712.text: Ah, I, um, don't know. I don't know yet...

721530713.text: I hope to finish the paper while I'm in Inazuma. If I can't get it done, I'll have to go back to the Akademiya to face the music.

721531301.text: That was a close shave... Well, alright then.
